name: Seeking Strahad
summary: Warlocks seek Strahad Farsan in Ratchet, where he can teach them to summon felhunters. Beneath the goblin port, his knowledge opens a path to more dangerous demons.

sections.title: A Summons Across the Sea
sections.body: Gakin the Darkbinder sends you from Stormwind to learn how to summon a felhunter. He guides warlocks in the Slaughtered Lamb below the Mage Quarter, but the rites call for knowledge beyond his reach. So you cross the Great Sea to Kalimdor, where another warlock may know the way.

sections.title: The Hermit of Ratchet
sections.body: Strahad Farsan lives in the arid hills above Ratchet, the goblin harbor. A human warlock and Gakin's peer in their secret cabal, he works from neutral territory. There, Alliance magistrates, church inquisitors, and Horde sentries are less likely to notice him. Warlocks come hoping to master demons that drain mana.

faq.q: Who sends you to find Strahad?
faq.answer: Gakin the Darkbinder sends you from the Slaughtered Lamb in Stormwind's Mage Quarter when you are ready to learn to summon a felhunter.
Strahad Farsan lives in the Barrens, in the heights overlooking Ratchet, the goblin port.

faq.q: Why does an Alliance warlock have to travel all the way to the Barrens?
faq.answer: Gakin cannot provide the lore and materials needed for the felhunter summoning rites in Stormwind. Strahad Farsan has that knowledge and works from neutral territory near Ratchet, away from local scrutiny.

faq.q: What ability does this quest lead to unlocking?
faq.answer: Speaking with Strahad begins a chain that leads to the Tome of the Cabal and the binding ritual for summoning a felhunter companion.

faq.q: Is Strahad Farsan hostile to the Horde?
faq.answer: No. Strahad lives in neutral goblin territory and instructs Alliance and Horde warlocks in summoning felhunters, while keeping ties with various cabals.

faq.q: What happens after you speak to Strahad?
faq.answer: Strahad asks you to gather the components for a binding ritual, beginning a chain involving the Tome of the Cabal.

angles.text: As a warlock, you leave basic fiends and succubi behind when you learn to summon the cunning, magic-draining felhunter.
As an Alliance warlock, you cross the Great Sea into Kalimdor's rugged, Horde-dominated heartland to reach Strahad.
